definitions: To discard something valuable along with something unwanted.
To reject the good parts of something along with the bad parts.
examples: Don't throw the baby out with the bathwater when you're revamping the old system.
We need to be careful not to throw the baby out with the bathwater during the budget cuts.
lemma: to throw the baby out with the bathwater
synonyms: to discard the good with the bad
source: to throw the baby out with the bathwater
